_comment: Capability 4. `preset` picks the baseline; `overrides` changes individual toggles on top of it. A toggle not listed in overrides always follows the preset, so switching preset really switches behaviour. Override the preset for one run with TOWN_MEMORY_PRESET=cross_enterprise.

_presets.open_lab: everything readable; for debugging a scenario
_presets.default: agents' memory is private; harness and observer may read it; a subject cannot see claims made about it
_presets.cross_enterprise: we do not define how the other side records memory and cannot read inside it; the observed lane is the only capture

_toggles.human_corrections: may a named person correct an agent's memory through the store (python3 -m gitmem.inspect correct)
_toggles.outside_edits: a fact file edited around the store: 'report' it and let the agent read it, or 'restore' it to its last commit before any agent reads
_toggles.signed_commits: 'off', or 'require': every commit must carry an SSH signature from a trusted key (keys in TOWN_GITMEM_KEYS, outside the memory folder)
